meta.name: month-end-close
meta.description: Run a month-end (or period) close checklist against a Well workspace — verify everything is reconciled and posted before the books are closed. Use when the user asks to close the month/period, run a close checklist, check if the books are ready to close, or what's left before closing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 核对并结清月度账目，确保财务数据完整
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每月需要系统性地完成财务结账流程
copy.tagline_en: Verify and close monthly accounts to ensure financial data integrity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically complete the month-end financial closing process

howto.what: Claude 会运行一个结账检查清单，依次检查银行对账、应收/应付、过账状态、试算平衡和税务，并报告每项是通过还是阻塞，列出具体缺漏，最后给出“准备关账”或“存在 N 个阻塞”的结论。
howto.when: 当你要求关账、运行关账检查清单、检查账本是否准备关账或关账前还剩下什么时触发。

say.text: 请检查本月账本是否可以关账。
say.note: Claude 会执行完整的结账检查。

say.text: 运行月末结账检查清单。
say.note: Claude 会逐项检查并报告结果。

say.text: 关账前还有哪些未完成事项？

howto.what_en: Claude runs a month-end close checklist: verifies bank reconciliation, receivables/payables, posting status, trial balance, and tax, then reports pass/blocker per item, lists specific gaps, and gives a verdict of 'ready to close' or 'N blockers remain'.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to close the month/period, run a close checklist, check if the books are ready to close, or what's left before closing.

say_en.text: Check if this month's books can be closed.
say_en.note: Claude will run the full close checklist.
Claude will check each item and report.
